verdict.rationale: Sprinto documents automated monitoring/alerts, webhooks that ingest events, and an AI Editor to create/modify ingestion workflows via natural language, which together support event-triggered automation. However, there's no explicit documentation of a general-purpose rules engine where users define arbitrary conditional triggers-to-actions logic across the platform. Missing for 10: explicit conditional rule/trigger builder documentation, examples of custom event-to-action mappings beyond monitoring/alerts and ingestion workflows, independent corroboration of this automation depth.
